When a dataset contains extreme outliers (like 900 in this case), the mean becomes heavily skewed and no longer represents a "typical" value. In statistics, the most robust measure of central tendency for skewed data is the median. 

Confidence Level: 100%

```python
import statistics

def typical_value(data):
    """
    Returns the median of the dataset as a string rounded to 2 decimal places.
    The median is chosen as the 'typical value' because it is robust against outliers.
    """
    median_val = statistics.median(data)
    return f"{float(median_val):.2f}"
```
